note: OP's price list (from 1 April 2025): a current account costs 2.50 euros a month, nothing for customers under 26 or for owner-members of their co-operative bank (membership isn't modelled). Nordea: a current account outside a service package costs 2.60 euros a month. Read again 2026-10-30 for OP (Nordea's page was saved again, its terms not read further): the OP Debit card costs 2.75 EUR a month, one card free under 18 and from 18 to 25 (waived under 26); euro withdrawals at any machine four free a month, then 0.70 EUR (written as free); withdrawals in another currency 2.00 EUR plus 2.75%; payments in OP's digital services are included in their monthly fee (domestic 0); a payment abroad online 6.00 EUR. An overdraft of the account is charged statutory late interest (at least 1.00 EUR) and 12.00 EUR a reminder, not written. Not stated: interest, a returned payment, the card's share on purchases in another currency, what opening asks.
